status: Targeted editing and small-text fixes implemented; the whole digitizer is not finished
changes: Image and native text editors expose 10% smaller / 10% larger actions through their existing size/history owners. Stitches rebuild, not coordinate-scale.
Native size validation reads the installed font's scale metadata instead of a fixed 4–6 mm application limit. Current enabled font inputs span 3.6–15.2 mm nominal size, not measured capital height.

A blocked cleanup request returns its preview and opens the existing review with keyboard focus. Keep all pending details records one Undoable choice; previous choices are preserved. Only 30 records render initially, with Show more and a complete downloadable report.

Native generation tries one explicit SVG securing-stitch pattern if the original file pair fails only short-stitch checks. It regenerates from the same source vectors, verifies both written files against the unchanged source envelope, and accepts the candidate only when every check passes. The result reports the adjustment before Save. Passing initial builds are untouched.
